// Local fixture only. Firebase write exports are intercepted in the test snapshot.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import AdminPanel from '../components/site/AdminPanel';
import SalePageV4 from '../components/site/SalePageV4';
import { DEFAULT_COMPANY_INFO } from '../components/site/SiteApp';
import { db, appId } from '../lib/firebaseClient';

const original = { id: 'fixture', project_name: 'บ้านทดสอบ', house_number: '99/118', price: 2090000,
  property_owner: 'Startup Up', category: 'ทาวน์เฮาส์', inventoryState: 'available',
  images: ['/featured/singlehouse.jpg'], highlights: 'จุดเด่นโครงการ\n- ตลาดหน้าโครงการ',
  access_details: 'ถนนเดิมที่ตรวจสอบแล้ว', renovation_details: 'เปลี่ยนพื้นแล้ว', nearby_places: 'ตลาดเดิม' };
export default function Fixture() {
  const [house, setHouse] = useState(original), [preview, setPreview] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    window.__testSaveProperty = data => { window.savedProperty = data; setHouse({ ...data, id: 'fixture' }); };
    window.__testPreview = () => setPreview(true);
    return () => { delete window.__testSaveProperty; delete window.__testPreview; };
  }, []);
  return preview ? <SalePageV4 property={house} properties={[]} companyInfo={DEFAULT_COMPANY_INFO} onBack={() => setPreview(false)} />
    : <AdminPanel userRole="host" userEmail="fixture@example.test" properties={[house]} users={[]} companyInfo={DEFAULT_COMPANY_INFO}
        locations={[]} db={db} appId={appId} onClose={() => setPreview(true)} onLogout={() => {}}
        showAlert={(title, message) => { window.testAlert = { title, message }; }} showConfirm={() => {}} />;
}
